title: Add a device
scanHint: On the new device, install Password365 and choose {setup}, then scan this code or paste the text below. Both devices must be on the same network.
waiting: Waiting for the new device… The code works once and expires in 5 minutes.
checkCode: Type the 6-digit code the new device shows:
finishing: Waiting for the master password on the new device…
wrongCode: That is not the code the new device shows. For your safety the pairing was stopped: start again.
